decisions.reason: After several years with no later website presence, this bread looks insufficiently differentiated from the core assortment, so its option value now appears too low to justify keeping it.
The sweet pastry was cheap to test, but the lack of later visibility suggests the market signal has largely resolved and does not warrant further commitment versus other confectionery options.
As a core bread product using existing capabilities and showing no clear negative evidence, it remains a low-cost option worth keeping open for another year.
This flagship poppy seed Christmas stollen has strong positive quality signaling from the gold award and fits the firm's heritage positioning, so keeping it is clearly justified.
The premium Christmas stollen also has a gold-award signal and sits close to the firm's seasonal specialty strengths, making continued offering the better option.
